description: This file provides support for OVHCloud AI endpoints, integrating features similar to OpenAI's API, including configuration classes, URL management, request transformation, error handling, and streaming response parsing specifically for OVHCloud's chat API.

classes.name: OVHCloudChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OVHCloud chat models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig to specify provider details, handle parameter support, URL construction, error mapping, and request transformation.

classes.name: OVHCloudChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming chat completion responses from OVHCloud API, parsing chunks, extracting choices, and managing errors during streaming.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the provider name indicating OVHCloud as the source of the LLM.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns supported parameters for a given model, considering function calling support.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for chat completions.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for errors.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and filters openai parameters for OVHCloud models.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the request payload, including optional extra body data.

methods.name: ModelResponseStream chunk_parser(self, chunk: dict)
methods.description: Parses streaming response chunks, handling errors and choices, and returning a structured ModelResponseStream.
